;;
;; If you need to manually run PgBouncer (for debugging), you can generate
;; the userlist.txt by running the entrypoint script:
;;   ./infrastructure/core/pgbouncer/entrypoint.sh
;;
;; For more information, see:
;;   - infrastructure/core/pgbouncer/SCRAM_SHA256_UPGRADE_GUIDE.md
;;   - https://www.pgbouncer.org/config.html#authentication-file-format
